headline: Olam Agri Breaks Ground on $70 Million Feed Mill in Delta State
summary: Delta State Governor Sheriff Oborevwori performed the ground-breaking ceremony for a $70 million integrated animal feed mill by Olam Agri.
why: Large-scale agricultural investments expand regional processing capacity and reflect corporate capital expenditure in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Foreign and domestic direct investment in agricultural infrastructure supports local economic output.
